assumptions: The population is one the strategy (or a saved cluster) defines on this file.
limits: FCS is written as float32 list mode, as FlowIO writes it.
bio.jane/contract.question: Give me this population's events as a file another tool can open.

description: One population's events as a file: FCS 3.1 (FlowIO create_fcs, returned as base64) or CSV (returned as text).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

computed.description: also write the run's derived and unmixed channels.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

format.description: the file format. Values: fcs (FCS 3.1), csv (CSV).

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

population.description: the population to write, by its gate id; empty for every event.

values.description: acquired values with the spillover keyword, or the compensated values. Values: raw (as acquired), compensated (compensated).

name: export_flow_cytometry_population

file.description: the file: its name, MIME type, event count, and the CSV text or the FCS bytes as base64
